name: mock-scraperapi
description: Mock ScraperAPI (scraperapi.com) for local tests. Forwards requests where the target URL is passed as ?url= query param, mimicking ScraperAPI's wire protocol. Accepts any api_key, rotates X-Forwarded-For per request to mimic residential IP rotation, injects X-ScraperApi-Trace-Id fingerprint. Streams response (Range not supported — full GET only, just like real ScraperAPI).
